title: Toward the “Roche of Pet Medicine”: Protect Biotech’s Platform Bet
summary: As companion animals age and owners become more willing to pay for serious-disease care, the next major question in pet medicine is whether a platform company can connect drugs, diagnostics, veterinary clinics, regulation, manufacturing, channels, and data into one defensible system.
